text:
maria: Heads-up from AE — DeltaBank wants a binding retention offering: 6y immutable audit logs + verifiable escrow for BYOK. They need a customer-facing checklist by Friday.
kevin: Is this an upstream SOC2 ask or a bespoke contract?
sophie: Contract-specific + auditor confirmation. Theywant a mechanism to get a signed evidence bundle during audits.
david: Main engineering questions: 1) how to guarantee immutability across clouds, 2) retrieval SLAs for archived data, 3) how to produce a tamper-evident manifest.
maria: Sales says pilot approval depends on our published acceptance criteria and a clear fallback if BYOK handshake fails.
legal: Note: any escrow wording must be reviewed by Legal; don't promise escrow without contract language. :gavel:
kevin: Proposed split of workstreams: Retention & lifecycle, Export + evidence bundle, BYOK handshake + escrow attestation, UI/admin controls, Billing.
sophie: Draft ACs below — please comment inline.
sophie: ```
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (initial):
- Retention: tenant-configurable retention up to 6 years; storage lifecycle enforced automatically; append-only semantics for audit events.
- Immutability: leverage provider object-lock/WORM or equivalent for on-prem; versioning with retention locks where supported.
- Export SLA: Export job returns an encrypted export bundle + signed SHA256 manifest and ingestion receipts within 72h of request.
- Manifest contents: tenant_id, time_range, event_count, total_bytes, sha256 of bundle, RFC3339 timestamp, signer identity.
- BYOK: support customer-supplied wrap keys for envelope encryption; staging supports simulated escrow for auditor review.
- Escrow attestation: legal-signed template + timestamped HSM signature proving key-wrapping exchange (no plaintext exposure).
- Fallback: explicit consent flow for platform-managed keys with contract checkbox; fallback path must be surfaced in onboarding UI.
- Ops: runbook, escalation, and recovery steps; cost estimate and billing pass-through flag for long-retention customers.
```
kevin: Add: state clearly which clouds support true object-lock and which require best-effort. infra-bot, can you enumerate?
infra-bot: s3-object-lock: supported; gcs-retention-policy: limited; azure-immmutability-policy: supported; onprem: depends on storage (need WORM or append-only). Will post matrix tomorrow.
david: Tech notes: we can generate manifest with chained SHA256 + include ingestion receipts. For attestation we need HSM-signed timestamps — ops needs HSM access and legal-signed template.
legal: We'll prepare a short escrow attestation template and list required fields auditors expect.
sophie: Timeline proposal: 3 days discovery, legal draft 5 days, eng spike 4 days, MVP build 2 weeks. Target pilot ~6 weeks.
maria: Sales requests a one-pager summarizing limits, expected retrieval windows for archived ranges, and a clear 'what we won't do' section.
kevin: Risk register: 1) escrow SLA negotiation, 2) retrieval latency & cost, 3) regional residency. Mitigations: pre-approved clauses, tiered retrieval SLAs, region-aware storage placement.
david: Action items: kevin + david to spec export job and manifest format; infra to deliver support matrix; legal to draft escrow template; sophie to write the one-pager + acceptance checklist.
maria: I'll loop in AE and customer with a draft by EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
